name: data-table-column-group
title: DataTable Column Group
description: Column header option to group rows by column values with TanStack aggregation support.

files.content: /** * niko-table — created by Semir N. (Semkoo, https://github.com/Semkoo) with AI assistance. * * Before reporting anything: please check the changelog first. * - In-repo: ./CHANGELOG.md * - Docs site: https://niko-table.com/changelog * * Found a bug or have a fix? Open an issue or PR on GitHub so other * users (and future LLMs reading this code) benefit: * https://github.com/Semkoo/niko-table-registry */ import type { RowData } from "@tanstack/react-table" import { CircleHelp, Group, Ungroup } from "lucide-react" import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button" import { DropdownMenu, DropdownMenuContent, DropdownMenuItem, DropdownMenuLabel, DropdownMenuSeparator, DropdownMenuTrigger, } from "@/components/ui/dropdown-menu" import { Tooltip, TooltipContent, TooltipTrigger, } from "@/components/ui/tooltip" import { cn } from "@/lib/utils" import type { DataTableColumn } from "../types" /** * Dropdown menu items for grouping rows by a column. * Use inside a DropdownMenuContent or as a child of TableColumnActions. * * @example * ```tsx * * * * ``` */ export function TableColumnGroupOptions({ column, withSeparator = true, }: { column: DataTableColumn /** Whether to render a separator before the options. Defaults to true. */ withSeparator?: boolean }) { const canGroup = column.getCanGroup() const isGrouped = column.getIsGrouped() if (!canGroup) return null return ( <> {withSeparator && } Column Group Group rows by this column's values. Nested groups follow the order you group columns. {isGrouped ? ( column.toggleGrouping()} className="flex items-center" > Stop grouping by ) : ( column.toggleGrouping()} className="flex items-center" > Group by )} ) } /** * Standalone dropdown menu for grouping a column. * * @example * ```tsx * * ``` */ export function TableColumnGroupMenu({ column, className, }: { column: DataTableColumn className?: string }) { const canGroup = column.getCanGroup() const isGrouped = column.getIsGrouped() if (!canGroup) return null return ( Column Group Group rows by this column's values. Nested groups follow the order you group columns. {isGrouped ? ( column.toggleGrouping()} className="flex items-center" > Stop grouping by ) : ( column.toggleGrouping()} className="flex items-center" > Group by )} ) } TableColumnGroupOptions.displayName = "TableColumnGroupOptions" TableColumnGroupMenu.displayName = "TableColumnGroupMenu"
